commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Alex Baena (Villarreal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+4' It looks like Gerard Moreno may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Marcelino replaces him with Pau Cabanes (Villarreal).
90+3' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) skips around Junior Reis and has the goal at his mercy but unbelievably misses the empty net. Hold your head in shame son!
90+1' Ath Bilbao are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
85' Here is a change. Inaki Williams is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) replaces Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
84' Alex Baena (Villarreal) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.

83' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick is awarded to Villarreal.
81' A cross from a corner kick by Villarreal is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
80' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
78' Poor challenge! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Victor Garcia blows his whistle.
75' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Yeremy Pino is replaced by Denis Suarez (Villarreal).
73' Diego Conde (Villarreal) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Junior Reis comes onto the pitch to replace him.
71' Diego Conde (Villarreal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' 2 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) was set free in the area by Oihan Sancet and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
68' Substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Gorka Guruzeta walks off.
68' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) replacing Benat Prados Diaz.
68' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
66' Diego Conde pulls off a great save to deny Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
65' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:7.
64' Villarreal are ruled offside.
64' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
62' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) prepares to take a corner kick.
62' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Corner kick. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity.
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alex Berenguer will be replaced by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao).
60' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
59' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
58' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
58' Logan Costa (Villarreal) smashes the ball upfield and Yeremy Pino brings it down with a fine first touch.
57' Villarreal are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
55' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
52' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
50' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
48' Villarreal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Dani Parejo (Villarreal) comes off for Ayoze Perez.
46' Marcelino makes a half-time substitution. Gerard Moreno comes on in place of Thierno Barry (Villarreal).
46' The whistle blows and Victor Garcia starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Flag goes up against Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
42' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.

41' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Julen Agirrezabala, who pulls off a comfortable save!
41' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
40' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
35' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
33' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
31' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Diego Conde intercepts the ball.
22' The goal by Villarreal is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
22' The Villarreal players halt their celebrations as referee Victor Garcia makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

21' It's the free kick. Pape Gueye (Villarreal) gets on the end of a cross from Alex Baena and shows great technique to fire the ball into the back of the net. His effort from the edge of the box flies into the bottom right corner and changes the score to 1:0.
20' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes a direct free kick.
20' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Victor Garcia stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
19' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' 1 - 0 The corner from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta goes into a dangerous area and finds Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao), who outjumps the defence and glances a header into the back of the net. 1:0.
14' The ball is out of play and Ath Bilbao manage to earn a corner.
13' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
13' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
12' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) brings his opponent down. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
10' This shall not pass! Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
10' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds Oscar de Marcos with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
4' A perfect long pass by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) finds Yuri Berchiche. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
3' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

Ath Bilbao will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Victor Garcia.
